en: A diamond ring to grace a lady's slender
fingers ever so beautifully, sir.
Is it a present for your sweetheart?
It takes courage to express one's feelings,
but these jewels will help lend you
that courage...
Until you find a piece that pleases you,
please take your time and look around.
Have you made your choice?
I'll take this necklace.
This necklace sets off a lady's skin
most beautifully.
I'm fond of women with lovely throats...
Ah, is that so, sir?
A very... refined taste you have, sir.
We look forward to your next visit.
My apologies.
note: Next row #2565 starts with a capital ('We're already closed...'), so a full sentence here.

en: I'm afraid the shop is closed, so
A-a thief?!
What on earth has happened?
W-waaaaaaah...
Such beauty, and such coldness...
...A jewel is a dead, unmoving thing,
so why does it enthrall people so?
If she's your sweetheart, she must be
a charming lady indeed.
Until you find a piece that pleases you,
I'll take this ring.
My apologies.
At my master's command, I would give up
even my very life...
I can't really remember my family back home.
My head's in a fog every day, whatever I do.
Please, give me your orders. Come now...
By day I'm sluggish and can't move, but at
night my head's clear and I'm full of strength. Odd.
Ah, it's been ages since I talked to anyone.
Oh? And why is that...?
My name is Nick. I came here to London
to earn a living. My family's in the country,
and I work at the factory morning till night...
We shall meet again.
That match factory is where I work.
Good morning. Hello there.
Another full day at the factory today. Bye.
Good morning. Glad to see you looking well.
You must come from a wealthy family.
You always seem so at ease.
Toiling away every day as I do, I sometimes
find this life so empty...
You look unwell. What's the matter?
Oh, it's nothing.
I'm just worn out from nonstop work. Dizzy...
Why not go to a hospital and see
a doctor?
I've no time or money for that.
I came all the way from the country to work.
I can't go resting. My family...
Thank you for your kindness, but
I'll be fine... Goodbye now.
Oh, really, I'm fine...
Thanks for the other day. I'm managing
to keep working now, thanks to you.
Once I've saved up enough, I'd like to go
home. I hope that day comes soon.
Good evening. We do meet often, don't we?
You seem to have a busy job too.
It's odd for me of all people to say, but...
please do look after your health.
Ah, you mustn't go into the factory.
This is a match factory. We handle phosphorus,
so no one but staff may come in!
Phosphorus... A dangerous substance.
Unavoidable in a match factory, though.
Yes, phosphorus is poisonous.
Please go outside at once.
At this rate, the manager will scold me.
My apologies.
I shall take my leave.
Not at all. If you feel unwell, please be sure
